name: Make an Object
about: Describe a thing (add a photo or drawing if you like) and Claude makes it as an Object: its 2D symbol and 3D primitive. In a project you keep it there, and can have its detailed version made next (Detail an Object); in the studio you propose it to the Library.

input.about: What to make: its name, sizes and how it looks; photos or drawings help.

rules.text: Agents never change the Library or the project's model. They write the run's Needs, matches and draft Objects; only the owner's decisions change the project.
A made Object passes the Library check: its 2D symbol and 3D primitive agree at every parameter setting, every parameter has limits and changes something, sizes are whole millimetres.
A made Object is a Project Object: its id is project.<name>@1.0.0 and it stays in the project until the owner asks for it to be proposed to the Library.
Measure in millimetres. When a size is not given, use a usual size for the kind of thing and say so in the Need's notes.

steps.name: Make
steps.outcome: The thing described is an Object whose 2D symbol and 3D primitive agree at every parameter setting.

steps.name: Keep
steps.question: Keep these Objects in the project? They are pinned to it, ready to attach to a line, face or point; they stay out of the Library until you ask for them to be proposed. Not right? Write what to do differently and send it back.

steps.name: Propose to the Library
steps.question: Propose these Objects to the Library? Each goes by its own Propose to Library run (a pull request you merge). Not right? Write what to change and send it back.

output.name: Made Objects
output.about: The Object made and whether it was kept.

useWhen: The owner describes one thing to make (with a photo or drawing if they have one) and wants it as an Object in the project.
